messages:
Priya: FYI: Edge Privacy Mode v1.0 is GA for on-prem/VPC customers tonight. Main change: tenant-level telemetry switch defaults to OFF and an audit-record gets generated when customers opt in. Rollout window and checklist below.
release-bot: Artifact published: edge-privacy@v1.0 -> s3://internal-releases/edge-privacy/v1.0. Rollout: 2025-10-12 23:00 UTC -> 2025-10-13 02:00 UTC. Canary: 10% for 30m.
Marco: Quick confirm: default is telemetry disabled for new tenants? We had a compliance-sensitive pilot asking for explicit opt-in only.
Priya: Yes 100% default OFF. Opt-in only when customer explicitly records consent; audit bundle stored per-tenant.
ops-bot: Canary health checks OK in us-west2 and eu-west3. No increase in 5xx or agent reconnects in the last 10m.
support-team: Coverage: @Marco and @Leah for the window. Escalate registration/connectivity to #eng-runtime immediately.
compliance: Note: audit bundle contains consent timestamp, consent method, and hashed metric IDs. We do NOT collect raw prompts. Retention default is 30 days; configurable.
Priya: Short customer-readiness checklist:
- Open management port TCP/15012 (runtime stays TCP/15011).
- Provide KMS/HSM credentials if they want locally-encrypted audit bundles.
- Decide opt-in policy and record consent using the API or Console.
API example to record consent:
curl -X POST https://mgmt.customer.example/api/v1/tenants/42/consent -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"consent":true, "method":"signed-policy"}'
Priya: I'll drop customer email templates and the Console copy after this thread. Monitoring for 4h post-rollout. :rotating_light:
